headline: Keyser Soze jumps from 1,910th to 66th on ARC-2

sections.text: Keyser Soze gained 20.14 to reach 49.17 on the ARC-2 public board, moving from 1,910th to 66th in the past day. The climb brings the entry into double-digit places, below the gold cutoff of 73.89.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
